messages.subject: dataProcess unable to complete
parts:
I've been using the MSstats.csv output from fragpipe for my unlabeled DDA MSstats analysis for a while now, but for some reason with my most recent data set the dataProcess function just seems to stall no matter how long I leave it. When I say stalls I mean on the 'Start the summarization per subplot...' step it doesn't get past 1%. However, the task manager still shows that my R session is actively using CPU and memory, so I know it's not frozen. If I take a smaller subset of the data (100,000 features) it stalls at the same place but at 6%. I've troubleshooted by restarting R, my PC, updating all packages, checking that I have the most recent MSstats version, and re-running the analysis on a similar data set (which worked as expected). I attached the log file and a sample of the fragpipe output data. I'm wondering If i overlooked something obvious?

I appreciate the help,
Scott

messages.author: 213804ad0e79002c
messages.subject: Re: dataProcess unable to complete
parts:
Okay So the issue it turns out was RAM. After looking around on the forms I found the one "MSstats::dataProcess RAM overflow for SpectroNaut input" very useful. The difficult part was that I didn't get any error telling me what the possible issue could be. After following Christian Schori suggestion of setting the R_MAX_VSIZE to a higher value, with no luck, I followed his later suggestion of setting the "featureSubset" argument in dataProcess to "topN", then setting "n_top_feature" = 1000. The processing step looked like it initially stalled but after a few minutes was able to finish.

Thank you past Christian
